verdict.rationale: A Sandbox project gives access to the non-billable, unlimited Test Drive plan covering all Open Finance endpoints. The docs provide test banks (FinBanks), a test payroll provider (FinPayroll), and testing personas with a wide variety of profiles for different scenarios, and accounts are linked via Connect. Missing for 10: explicitly documented test usernames/passwords per persona, documented simulation of error states (e.g., MFA failures, institution errors), and independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end sandbox flow.
